title: The Five Pillars — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Islam's five pillars are the Shahada, the declaration of faith, Salah, the five daily prayers, Zakat, almsgiving, Sawm, fasting in Ramadan, and Hajj, pilgrimage. Zakat is typically two and a half percent of qualifying wealth held for a lunar year. This overview edition presents The Five Pillars within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.

spec.overview: Islam's five pillars are the Shahada, the declaration of faith, Salah, the five daily prayers, Zakat, almsgiving, Sawm, fasting in Ramadan, and Hajj, pilgrimage. Zakat is typically two and a half percent of qualifying wealth held for a lunar year.
sacred_texts: Hadith: Islam is built upon five, in al-Bukhari and Muslim
spec.adherents: Obligatory for all adult Muslims, with zakat and hajj conditioned on means.

example.fact: The pillars structure a Muslim's belief, daily rhythm, wealth, year, and lifetime.

spec.study_note: Core facts verified from public sources; adherent figures are estimates from the Pew Research Center.
